title: feat: ViewDesigner drag-to-reorder, extract config primitives, add DashboardConfig types
body:
Implements three roadmap items (P1.1, P1.10 Phase 0, P1.10 Phase 5) to advance Airtable UX parity and dashboard infrastructure.

### ViewDesigner column drag-to-reorder (P1.1)

Replaces `ArrowUp`/`ArrowDown` buttons with `@dnd-kit` drag handles. The existing `GripVertical` icon becomes a functional drag handle via `useSortable`.

- New `SortableColumnItem` component wraps each column with `useSortable`
- `DndContext` + `SortableContext` with `verticalListSortingStrategy`
- `handleDragEnd` → `pushState()` for undo/redo integration
- Selection tracking follows the dragged column

```tsx
<DndContext sensors={sensors} collisionDetection={closestCenter} onDragEnd={handleDragEnd}>
  <SortableContext items={columns.map((_, i) => `col-${i}`)} strategy={verticalListSortingStrategy}>
    {columns.map((col, index) => (
      <SortableColumnItem key={...} col={col} index={index} ... />
    ))}
  </SortableContext>
</DndContext>
```

### Extract ConfigRow / SectionHeader (P1.10 Phase 0)

- Moved from inline definitions in `ViewConfigPanel` to `@object-ui/components/custom`
- Added `className` prop for extensibility
- `ViewConfigPanel` now imports from `@object-ui/components`

### DashboardConfig types + Zod validation (P1.10 Phase 5)

- `DashboardConfig`, `DashboardWidgetConfig` interfaces in `designer.ts`
- `DASHBOARD_COLOR_VARIANTS` and `DASHBOARD_WIDGET_TYPES` as shared `as const` arrays — single source of truth for both TS types (`typeof X[number]`) and Zod enums
- `DashboardConfigSchema` / `DashboardWidgetConfigSchema` Zod validators

### Tests

- 33 new tests (5 drag-reorder, 12 config primitives, 16 dashboard types/zod)
- 250 total passing across all affected packages
